title: Codex CLI non-interactive runs now require explicit project trust
summary: Codex 0.169.0 fixes project-trust handling: exec keeps untrusted project configuration and MCP servers disabled even with workspace-write. Explicit trust persists for future sessions and includes MCP commands outside the sandbox.

severity.rationale: This release tightens a trust boundary for unattended runs in untrusted repositories. The sources do not establish an affected version range or exploitation, so this record describes the documented hardening.

affected.note: Release containing the documented fix. The sources do not give an affected version range.

exposure: Relevant to codex exec automation processing untrusted repositories with workspace-write permissions.

params.instructions: Check Codex CLI version and project-trust settings used by non-interactive jobs. Review explicit trust grants separately from sandbox write permissions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Use 0.169.0 or later for the documented behavior; grant --trust only after reviewing project configuration and MCP commands.
remediation.risk: Medium. Jobs relying on implicit project trust can lose configured tools.

verification: Use a harmless untrusted fixture to confirm project configuration and MCP servers stay disabled under workspace-write without explicit trust.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
